results.title: Mass protests in Madrid and Paris signal systemic economic crisis in Western nations
results.description: Protest movements spanning major cities from New York to Buenos Aires are exhibiting synchronized demands that point to a systemic crisis in resource distribution, moving beyond isolated local incidents. In Europe and the United States, demonstrations are targeting specific economic mechanisms. In Madrid, tens of thousands took to the streets against "rentier capitalism” and real estate speculation, arguing that housing has shifted from a basic necessity to a financial asset. In France, the Confédération Générale du Travail reported that nearly 800,000 people protested, demanding tax fairness reviews and the restoration of purchasing power amid inflation. In Belgium and Portugal, the focus remains on austerity measures and labor law reforms that reduce social guarantees for young people. The Latin American region shows similar dynamics but emphasizes human capital infrastructure. In Chile and Argentina, primary demands center on funding for state education and science. In Colombia and Ecuador, protests have been triggered by budget cuts and attempts to repeal labor rights, directly impacting the real incomes of working populations. These social shifts are translating into political outcomes through electoral mechanisms. In Serbia, protest movements contributed to a change in power after 14 years of Alexander Vučić's rule. In Israel, the Netanyahu bloc lost its parliamentary majority. In Brazil, mass actions, including demands to revise work schedules (such as abolishing the 6x1 work week), were a factor in the victory of Lula.
creator: evgeniya petrova

results.title: Keralam: Prakash Raj raises ‘Azadi’ slogans in Kochi, evokes 2020 anti-CAA protests and Delhi riots
results.description: Actor Prakash Raj raised controversial “Azadi” slogans at a public rally in Kochi on November 7, echoing slogans raised during the 2020 anti-CAA agitation in Delhi by Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam. The slogans, which featured calls for freedom from police action, imprisonment and physical punishment, have renewed attention to the nature of political mobilisation surrounding the anti-CAA protests. The slogans raised by Prakash Raj included: Thum Dande Maaro ….. Aazaadi Thum Kuch Bhee Karlo …. Aazaadi Thum Jel Me Daalo ….. Aazaadi Police Bhulaao ….. Aazaadi The 2020 anti-CAA agitation witnessed the raising of similar slogans, particularly at Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), Delhi. The controversy surrounding the agitation also brought figures such as Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam into the spotlight. Reports had also linked several political activists and public figures, including Supreme Court lawyer Prashant Bhushan and Yogendra Yadav, to the broader political mobilisation surrounding the protests and the 2020 Delhi riots. Alleged actor Prakash Raj can be seen going out of control at the CJP protest against SIR and Gyanesh Kumar in Kochi, Kerala, surrounded by his favourite crowd. He can be seen raising “Azadi, Azadi” slogans, echoing the rhetoric associated with dangerous separatist movements in… pic.twitter.com/Ilhn6Nx1o1 — Megh Updates 🚨™ (@MeghUpdates) November 7, 2026 Following the march, Prakash Raj and Abhijith Deepke addressed a public meeting attended by Left leaders, including CPM-CPI functionaries, and writers critical of the Modi government and the RSS. Deepke repeated the allegation that voters’ names were being removed from electoral rolls for not voting for the BJP. He also reiterated the Campaign for Judicial Accountability and Reforms (CJP)’s demand for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Anti-Hindu Delhi Riots 2020: When evidence outlasted narratives Earlier in the day, Prakash Raj visited the protest pandal set up by suspended SFI activists at Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit, Kalady. The students have been agitating against their suspension and demanding permission to appear for their examinations. The university had suspended them following their alleged involvement in storming a Syndicate meeting, confronting Vice-Chancellor Dr Ciza Thomas and staging her symbolic funeral. The students’ demand to be allowed to write their examinations is currently under judicial scrutiny. Addressing the protesting students, Prakash Raj said he would join their agitation if the government failed to take the initiative to resolve the issue. CPM state secretary M.V. Govindan also visited the protesting SFI workers. Describing Kalady as another Jantar Mantar, he said the university had begun attracting attention in a manner similar to the prominent protest site in Delhi. Reiterating the CPM’s familiar political argument, Govindan accused both the Congress and the BJP of attempting to saffronise the university.

results.title: Iran Executes Three More Men Following Mass Protests
results.description: Iranian authorities have executed three more men in connection with the mass protests in January. They were accused of acting against Iran’s national security and interests on behalf of Israel, the United States, and “hostile groups,” according to the legal news portal Misan.
